<p>Examples demonstrating accessing and working with ocean satellite data from ERDDAP servers.</p>

<p>To view all tutorials, visit our <a href="https://coastwatch-training.github.io/tutorials/" target="_blank">Satellite Data Training Code Gallery</a>.</p>

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Use a more forgiving encoding to avoid UnicodeDecodeError
df = pd.read_csv("spreadsheets/tutorials.csv", encoding="latin1")

# Generate tutorial cards
html = '<div class="tutorial-grid">'

for _, row in df.iterrows():
    python_url = str(row.get("python_url", "")).strip()
    r_url = str(row.get("r_url", "")).strip()
    matlab_url = str(row.get("matlab_url", "")).strip()

    links = []

    if python_url and python_url.lower() != "nan":
        links.append(f'<a href="{python_url}" target="_blank">View Python Tutorial</a>')

    if r_url and r_url.lower() != "nan":
        links.append(f'<a href="{r_url}" target="_blank">View R Tutorial</a>')

    if matlab_url and matlab_url.lower() != "nan":
        links.append(f'<a href="{matlab_url}" target="_blank">View MATLAB Tutorial</a>')

    links_html = "<br>".join(links) if links else "<span>Coming soon</span>"

    html += f'''
    <div class="tutorial-card">
        <img src="{row['image']}" alt="{row['alt']}" style="cursor: zoom-in;" onclick="openLightbox(this.src)">
        <div class="tags">{row['tags']}</div>
        <h3>{row['title']}</h3>
        <p>{row['description']}</p>
        <p>{links_html}</p>
    </div>
    '''

html += '</div>'

display(HTML(html))
```

<!-- Lightbox Container --> 
<div id="lightbox" style="display:none !important; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100vw; height:100vh; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; z-index:9999;" onclick="closeLightbox()"> <img id="lightbox-img" src="" style="max-width:95vw; max-height:90vh; box-shadow:0 0 20px black; cursor:zoom-out; object-fit: contain;"> </div>


<!-- Lightbox Script --> 
<script> function openLightbox(src) { const img = document.getElementById('lightbox-img'); const box = document.getElementById('lightbox'); img.src = src; box.style.display = 'flex'; } function closeLightbox() { document.getElementById('lightbox').style.display = 'none'; } </script>
